messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
邁克贏了。  
邁克的手牌 9♠ 10♠ J♠ Q♠ K♠ 是一條順子開牌（Straight Flush），而約翰的 8♥ 10♥ J♥ Q♥ K♥ 只是一手開牌（Flush）。在撲克中，順子開牌比開牌高，故邁克勝出。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush from 8 to K? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K is a straight flush (8-10-J-Q-K). That's a straight flush. Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a straight flush from 9 to K? Wait 9-10-J-Q-K is a straight flush. So both have straight flushes. Compare highest card: John's highest is K♥, Mike's highest is K♠. They tie. But we need to compare next highest? Actually in straight flush, the ranking is by highest card. If same, then compare next? But if both have same high card, they are equal. But maybe we consider suits? In standard poker, suits don't matter. So it's a tie. But maybe we need to consider that John's straight flush starts at 8, Mike's starts at 9. So Mike's straight flush is higher because it starts at 9. Actually the ranking of straight flush is by highest card. Both have K as highest. But the sequence matters: 8-9-10-J-Q-K? Wait John's sequence: 8,10,J,Q,K. That's missing 9. So it's not a straight flush? Wait a straight requires consecutive ranks. John's cards: 8,10,J,Q,K. That's 8,10, J, Q, K. That's missing 9. So it's not a straight. It's a flush with high cards 8,10,J,Q,K. That's a flush. Mike's cards: 9,10,J,Q,K. That's a straight flush? Actually 9,10,J,Q,K is consecutive. So Mike has a straight flush. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
